args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate was 18% and health checks were failing. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully and is verified as rolled out.

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running **v2.3.1** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history confirmed **v2.3.1** was the latest production deploy and was **unhealthy**; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (seq 1).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** `checkout-api` to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — rollback completed and verified (`status: rolled_out`).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status: `checkout-api` is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions, with error rate down to 0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the unhealthy release and should be investigated before any future redeploy.
